observed_by: wrangler 4.141.0 `kv namespace list` on the operator machine - an authenticated, read-only read of this account's KV namespace list (owner OAuth credential; no write was made).
reproduce: wrangler kv namespace list  ->  the JSON array, mapped to {id,title} and sorted by id, serialised with 2-space indent and a trailing newline; sha256 = list_sha256 below.
note: A dated observation, not a standing truth. This receipt is consulted ONLY when no credential available to the run can read the account's KV namespace list; the bind step then names this receipt in its output, with observed_at, so a reader is never told a live read happened when it did not. Refresh it by re-running the list and updating observed_at, list_sha256 and namespaces. If a binding is added to wrangler.jsonc, this receipt must be refreshed before that binding can be bound: the step fails closed on a receipt that does not cover every declared id.
